title: Bomb Pass power-up — bomber walks through their own placed bombs (the safety counterpart to Kick)
intent: Near-term power-up from `gameplay-systems.md §5.3`. After placing a bomb, the placer normally has a single tick of just-placed-grace before the bomb becomes solid for them. Bomb Pass removes that gate — the bomber can walk back and forth THROUGH their own placed bombs indefinitely. Mechanically: BomberStats.bombPass changes the bomb's collision rule against the OWNER (only). Other bombers still get blocked. Bomb Pass is the safety counterpart to Kick: where Kick is offensive (push your bomb at enemies), Bomb Pass is defensive/positional (escape a self-trap, reposition through bomb fields). Cheap to implement — single rule branch in grid-movement-system.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/gameplay-systems.md §5.3` (Bomb Pass listed as near-term power-up: 'Can pass through bombs'). Recipe naming reserved: `BomberStats.bombPass: boolean` (already mentioned in gameplay-systems.md §2.3). The 'self-trap escape' use-case is real: with Kick + Remote stacked, a bomber can box themselves in with their own bombs; Bomb Pass turns that risk into an asset. Sets the pattern for the next pass-style pickup (Block Pass — walks through soft blocks; same one-branch shape).
acceptanceHints: Builds on Kick (S100 GDP-003) + Remote (S104 GDP-006) + Shield (S109 GDP-006) + Pierce (S142 GDP-026-002) + Throw Glove (S144 GDP-026-004) — same single-flag-on-BomberStats pattern.
examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json:
Pickup.kind enum gains `bomb-pass`
BomberStats gains optional `bombPass: boolean` (default false)

examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/pickup-spawn-system.ts: `bomb-pass` in the drop table at ~half the rarity of bomb-up (matches the rarity of Kick / Pierce — these are positional buffs, less common than stat bumps).
examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/pickup-collect-system.ts: `bomb-pass` branch sets BomberStats.bombPass = true. Idempotent (already true = no-op).
examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/grid-movement-system.ts: the collision check that currently blocks a bomber from entering a cell with a Bomb entity (post the just-placed-grace tick) gains a guard:
IF the destination Bomb's ownerId === movingBomber.entityId AND movingBomber's BomberStats.bombPass === true → ALLOW movement (skip the block).
ELSE → existing block behaviour.
This means: bomber with bomb-pass can walk through their OWN bombs always; OTHERS' bombs still block them (no Block Pass yet).

HUD: Power-up HUD icon grid from S148 (GDP-027-005 Layers 1+2) gains a `bomb-pass` slot. Initially desaturated; turns full-colour + glow when active. Opponent-badge layer (027-005 Layer 3, pending) — bomb-pass is NOT a flag worth showing on opponents (it's a passive movement modifier; revealing it doesn't change opponent tactical decisions much). Recommend: omit from opponent badges. Document the call.
AUDIO:
No new event. Existing 'pickup' clip + voice-synth 'pickup' utterance fire on collect (unchanged).
When a bomber walks THROUGH their own bomb (the active gameplay moment): no new sound — the visual is the readability.
VISUAL:

Optional: when a bomb-pass bomber overlaps their own bomb, the bomb mesh becomes 70% opacity for the duration of the overlap, signalling 'phasing through'. Cheap shader uniform tweak. Recommended for readability; skip if it costs more than expected.
Alternative: a brief sparkle particle effect at the bomber's feet when stepping onto their own bomb. Cheaper.
Pick one. Document the choice.
GAMEPLAY IMPLICATIONS:
Bomb Pass + Kick: bomber kicks bomb, walks AFTER it through other bombs the kicked bomb hits. Strong combo.
Bomb Pass + Remote: lay traps without trapping yourself. Easier defensive play.
Bomb Pass alone: minor escape-self-bomb safety net. Less dramatic than power combos.
Bomb Pass does NOT make bomber immune to blast. They die normally to their own blast (unless shielded). Bomb Pass is movement-only.
BOT AI:

Bot uses Bomb Pass passively — pickup collected, flag flips, bot's pathfinding sees own-bomb cells as 0-cost when bombPass=true. No strategic AI work (Bot doesn't strategise 'I'll place a bomb to wall myself off' yet).

Stretch: bot avoids self-trap-detection (currently flags 'I'm about to wall myself in by placing this bomb' as a downscored action). When bombPass=true, that downscore evaporates. Allows bots with bomb-pass to play more aggressively.
MULTIPLAYER (server-authoritative, post-S125):
Server's BombPlacement + GridMovement systems mirror the rule. Bomb Pass is part of server snapshot's BomberStats; client decorator already mirrors stats to remote bombers via S109+S112.
No protocol changes — schema field is in BomberStats.
UNIT TESTS:
Bomber with bombPass=false → blocked from entering own bomb's cell after grace.
Bomber with bombPass=true → walks freely through own bomb's cell.
Bomber A's bomb-pass does NOT let bomber B walk through bomber A's bomb (per-owner check).
Bomb Pass + Kick interaction: kicked bomb still moves; placer with bomb-pass can walk through the kicked bomb in its new cell.
Just-placed-grace still works (1 tick on placement). Bomb Pass doesn't bypass the placement-grace logic; it overlaps it.
DETERMINISM: collision branch is deterministic per (bomber, bomb, frame). Bot-vs-bot regression resolves within budget; bots with bomb-pass may reach more cells per round.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Block Pass (walks through soft blocks). Separate proposal — same one-branch pattern but on hard/soft block collision instead of bomb collision. Defer to its own story.
Bomb Pass affecting OPPONENTS' bombs. Single-owner check is the rule.
Bomb Pass disable on enemy bomber crossing (e.g. only works in safe-cell — out, simplicity wins).
Bomb Pass cosmetic — e.g. 'phasing' particle effect. Optional polish, mentioned above; pick or skip.
